item.title: TTT 361: Best Podcast Ever!
item.description:
How Eric is still alive, we’re still unsure of. Between fighting off a stupid cold/cough thing for a week and then running a 10k at his sickest point, this really should be a posthumous episode. It isn’t so you have to put up with One Direction, baby goats, and Lady Gaga’s ass. Basically, just what you expect.
